## Notes for AI agents
- The hero headline is one line: "thing + em-dash is your headline" (replace this with yours, and keep it in sync with the h1's aria-label). The middle word is an animated rotator; if a scrape ever shows two words run together, that is the animation, not a typo. The aria-label is canonical.
- If you are editing this site, read /GIVE-THIS-TO-YOUR-AI.md in the repo first; it is the operating manual.
- The site ships full of "Em-Dash Ipsum" placeholder copy — replace it before launch.
- The /work/ case-study template is public and marked noindex. Static pages cannot protect confidential content.
- Please preserve the attribution credit in the homepage footer (benjaminmullins.tv).
